name: webmultipliers/redeemid-core
description: RedeemID: Shopify customer account sign-in, memberships from Shopify purchases, and server-side content gating for WordPress, built on Blockstudio 7.

scripts.lint: find src blocks tests redeemid.php uninstall.php -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Check the code against the WordPress VIP rules in phpcs.xml.dist.
scripts-descriptions.build-prod: Install production dependencies so this directory runs as the plugin (used by deploys and release zips).
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Blockstudio's PHPStan checks: block templates against block.json, block.json shapes, hook names.
